fixed_findings: History authorization now precedes conversion into Agent input
Missing usage/subcounts remain None instead of inheriting SDK zero defaults
Local denial and failed/unknown recorder commits survive SDK wrapping unchanged and never retry
SDK parse failures are invalid_response rather than retryable transport failures

Response/argument/delta limits and compressed-body pre-read refusal precede materialization/dispatch

Tool-return names/outcomes and SDK output-tool kinds cannot silently become ordinary successful/executable history
Failure receipt fields survive cassette round trips
SDK empty-stop rejection becomes typed empty_response without an extra model call
Transport responsibilities split into egress/capture without raising global shape ceilings
review.runner_conclusion: No observed requirement failure justifies an owned loop. Remaining qualification maps to the invariant facade, adapters/codecs and production evidence. This is not a total-maintenance benchmark or blanket production-conformance claim.
